details:
ARES is an interactive Mars exploration and geospatial mapping platform developed by Team TERRA (Dev Upadhyaya – Team Lead/Research, Ojas Thakur – Software, Arush Kalra – Lead Developer). Instead of requiring researchers to switch between separate planetary archives, ARES integrates authentic mission observations into a single multi-layer Mars map. Users can toggle and compare six structured layers: Topography (elevation and slopes), Geology (rock formations and minerals), Imagery (orbital surface observations), Water-Ice Research (subsurface ice indicators), Terrain Analysis (exploration suitability), and Science Locations. Our initial build prioritizes MOLA, THEMIS, and HiRISE datasets as the core mapping foundation.

Key Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Unified Workflow: Eliminates the friction of cross-referencing fragmented orbital datasets across multiple tools.
  • Mission Readiness: By combining terrain safety, mineral composition, and subsurface water-ice indicators (for In-Situ Resource Utilization), ARES helps researchers identify scientifically valuable sites and vital resources for future astronaut exploration on Mars.
